name: zgeometry_clip_polygon_reset_weiler_state_from_contour_points
description: zGeometry_ClipPolygon::ResetWeilerStateFromContourPoints replaces a clip polygon's Weiler state from a point list while preserving the prior contour source.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler/clip-polygon source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x464790 validates the null point/count rejection, contourSource read from the old state, Init call for the replacement state, DestroyState call for the old state, and storing the new state pointer.
The native clip leaf smoke verifies null-point rejection without replacing the state and a successful replacement that preserves contourSource and input contour count.
